faq.label: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.title: Clear answers without the fluff.
faq.whatsappSubtitle: Chat directly with a team member on WhatsApp.

brands.a: You publish your campaign with your budget and criteria. Interested verified creators apply directly with their portfolio, and you freely choose who to partner with.

brands.q: How long does it take to publish a campaign?
brands.a: Your campaign is reviewed and approved by our team within 24 business hours. Once live, verified creators can start applying immediately.

brands.q: What happens if a creator fails to deliver?
brands.a: Every mission operates under a written agreement covering deliverables, deadlines, and revisions. Our team acts as a human mediator if issues arise.

creators.a: Yes, signing up and participating in the priority waitlist is completely free for creators.

creators.q: Do I need tens of thousands of followers?
creators.a: No. For UGC content, only your creative quality matters. For influencer partnerships, we work with engaged micro-creators starting from 1,000 followers.

creators.q: How and when do I get paid?
creators.a: The budget and payout schedule are stated in writing in the agreement before you begin creating. No project starts without upfront budget agreement.

general.a: Mosala means 'work' or 'job' in Lingala. It represents our mission: valuing creator craftsmanship and structuring brand investments.

general.q: How is Mosala different from other platforms?
general.a: Mosala is built for Central Africa, launching in the DRC: human profile verification, direct campaign applications, clear written terms, and local communication and payment realities.
We roll out access progressively to members on the priority waitlist to ensure high-touch onboarding.
